title: Eludite MCP tool descriptor
description: How Eludite's MCP server exports an agent-visible command (protocol/schemas/command-spec.json) in `tools/list` (MCP Tool, revision 2025-06-18 and later). The name is the command id with `.` replaced by `-` (MCP tool names cannot contain dots; command ids never contain `-`, so the mapping is reversible). The description is the input schema's root `description`. The input schema is the command's, without `$schema` and `$id`. The output schema is the command's when it describes an object; otherwise it is wrapped as `{"result": <output>}`, and so is `structuredContent`, because MCP requires an object. The list is computed from the command bus on every `tools/list`, so a command registered at runtime appears on the next list (the server also sends `notifications/tools/list_changed`). Image content: when the output schema marks a top-level string property with `"x-eludite-mcp-content": "image"` (base64, `contentEncoding: base64`), `tools/call`'s `content` gets `{"type": "image", "data": <the property>, "mimeType": <its contentMediaType>}` after the text part, and the text part and `structuredContent` carry the output with that property replaced by the string "(image content)", so the base64 is sent once. A `contentMediaType` of `image/*` means the type is read from the data's first bytes (PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP); the output of eludite.browser.screenshot is one.
